title: How we're helping the world prepare for natural disasters
gist: Google highlights its AI-driven crisis resilience tools on International ShakeOut Day, including expanding Android Earthquake Alerts and flood, cyclone and wildfire forecasting, under the goal that no one should be surprised by a natural disaster. It points to a new Crisis Resilience white paper.

insights.claim: Google's flood forecasting provides up to seven days' notice for riverine floods for more than two billion people in 150 countries, and up to 24 hours' notice for urban flash floods.
insights.speaker: Yossi Matias
insights.so_what: Shows scale of Google's applied-AI public-good deployments, relevant to climate-risk and insurance data ecosystems.
insights.quote: Our flood forecasting technology provides up to seven days' notice for riverine floods for more than two billion people in 150 countries

insights.claim: Google's WeatherNext model can predict cyclones up to 15 days out.
insights.speaker: Yossi Matias
insights.so_what: AI weather models extend lead times, a capability to watch for insurers and commodity traders.
insights.quote: WeatherNext can predict cyclones up to 15 days out.

insights.claim: Google has near-real-time fire boundary maps live in 34 countries, and its FireSat satellite constellation is designed to detect and track fires as small as a classroom within 20 minutes once completed.
insights.speaker: Yossi Matias
insights.so_what: FireSat is not yet complete; watch deployment progress as wildfire data feeds utilities and insurers.

insights.claim: The Android Earthquake Alerts System turns smartphones into a global network that can warn people before shaking arrives, and it is expanding to more countries and regions.
insights.speaker: Yossi Matias
insights.so_what: Smartphone-sensor networks are a distribution moat for Google's public-safety products.

insights.claim: In 2025 alone, Google helped connect people with crisis information more than 10 million times per day on average.
insights.speaker: Yossi Matias
insights.so_what: A usage metric indicating scale of Google's crisis-information surface.
